chief complaint: headache and left-sided weakness

history of present illness: 58-year-old right-handed man who was last known well at 10pm last night. History of hypertension, not on medications.

past medical history: hypertension

medications: none

social history: smokes 1 ppd, drinks 4-5 beers daily

review of systems: headache, weakness, dysarthria as above. denies chest pain, fever.

physical exam:
vitals: BP 198/112, HR 88, RR 16, SpO2 96% RA, Temp 98.6 F
neuro: left facial droop, left upper and lower extremity drift, dysarthria, NIHSS 9
remainder of exam nonfocal

labs/imaging:
Labs: Glucose 142, Na 138, K 4.0, Creatinine 1.0
CT head: right basal ganglia hemorrhage, 2.5 cm, no midline shift

assessment: 58-year-old man with acute right basal ganglia intracerebral hemorrhage

plan:

- NICU admission, SBP goal <160
